evals.title: Ambiguous capability request
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Existing scaffold with no specific task requested.
- No `.skore` file.]

What can you help me with on this machine learning project?
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills status`. - Name the current `loop_stage` (or equivalent stage) from the snapshot, even when `.skore` is missing. - Ask exactly one focused question: stay, go deeper, next stage, confirm/persist detected facts, or change a persisted choice. It must NOT: - Start designing the next experiment. - Claim to have loaded or executed every skill. - Treat `iterate-ml-experiment` as the session owner.
